human.summary: Adaptable people with broad ability and an extra language.

dawn.summary: An elf lineage with an intellect bonus and dawn heritage.

grove.summary: An elf lineage with a wisdom bonus and grove heritage.

dusk.summary: An elf lineage with a charisma bonus and dusk heritage.

elf.summary: Keen-sensed, graceful people with a light sleep and resistance to charm.

hearth.summary: A dwarf lineage with a wisdom bonus and hearth heritage.

stone.summary: A sturdy dwarf lineage with a strength bonus and stone heritage.

dwarf.summary: Tough, sure-footed folk known for poison resistance and stonecraft.

swift.summary: A swift halfling lineage with a charisma bonus.

steadfast.summary: A hardy halfling lineage with a constitution bonus.

halfling.summary: Small, quick people who recover from unlucky rolls and resist fear.

forest.summary: A forest gnome with a dexterity bonus and a bond with small beasts.

rock.summary: A rock gnome with a constitution bonus and tinkering craft.

gnome.summary: Small, clever folk with sharp minds and a gift for craft or nature.

orc.summary: Strong, relentless warriors who can push through defeat and rush foes.

red.summary: Red dragon ancestry grants a fire breath weapon.

blue.summary: Blue dragon ancestry grants a lightning breath weapon.

green.summary: Green dragon ancestry grants a poison breath weapon.

black.summary: Black dragon ancestry grants an acid breath weapon.

white.summary: White dragon ancestry grants a cold breath weapon.

dragonborn.summary: Proud draconic people with a breath weapon and elemental resistance.

infernal.summary: Infernal heritage shapes this tiefling’s innate magic.

abyssal.summary: Abyssal heritage shapes this tiefling’s innate magic.

chthonic.summary: Chthonic heritage shapes this tiefling’s innate magic.

tiefling.summary: People marked by fiendish heritage, with darkvision and hellish resistance.

half-breed.summary: Choose two parent ancestries; their traits and physical features shape this character.
